material.locator: OECD “Social Policy”, Context: “Public social spending” and Key message “The future of social protection could be put under pressure”; compare coverage, adequacy, delivery and take-up across OECD countries and periods.
material.description: Supports cross-country and time variation in social-spending levels and social-protection coverage/adequacy/delivery/take-up within the OECD evidence base; it does not establish a universal global ranking or individual eligibility conditions.
